title: Reusable and Scalable CSS (BEM & Utilities)
description: Learn methodologies and best practices for writing reusable, maintainable, and scalable CSS using BEM and utility classes.

lessons.title: Introduction to Scalable CSS
lessons.content: Why scalable CSS matters for large projects and maintainability.

lessons.title: Understanding BEM Methodology
lessons.content: Block, Element, Modifier naming convention and its benefits.

lessons.title: Structuring Projects with BEM
lessons.content: Organizing CSS files and components using BEM.

lessons.title: Introduction to Utility-First CSS
lessons.content: Using small, reusable utility classes for rapid development.

lessons.title: Combining BEM with Utility Classes
lessons.content: Best practices for combining structured BEM classes with utility helpers.

lessons.title: Avoiding CSS Specificity Issues
lessons.content: Tips to keep CSS specificity low and manageable.

lessons.title: Using Preprocessors with BEM
lessons.content: Nesting and variables in SCSS to support BEM structure.

lessons.title: Mini Project: Build a Reusable Component Library
lessons.content: Create a set of UI components using BEM and utility classes for reuse.
